name: Mareshah
title: Levite and ancestor in the lineage of Judah
summary: Mareshah (also known as Maresha) is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Judah through Caleb. He was the father of Hebron and belonged to an important lineage in the tribe of Judah. The city of Mareshah in Judah is linked to this name and played a role in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Caleb's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Mareshah is listed as the son of Caleb in the genealogical record of 1 Chronicles, as part of the tribe of Judah's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Father of Hebron
keyEvents.description: Mareshah is recorded as the father of Hebron, who himself became the ancestor of a significant lineage in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of the inheritance of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: As one of Caleb's descendants, Mareshah held a place in the important tribe of Judah, which would later give rise to David's royal line.

keyEvents.title: The city of Mareshah in the inheritance of Judah
keyEvents.description: The city of Mareshah in the lowlands of Judah is linked to this lineage and mentioned as one of the cities in Judah's inheritance.

keyEvents.title: King Asa and the battle at Mareshah
keyEvents.description: The city of Mareshah, named after the lineage, was the place where King Asa of Judah fought against the Ethiopian army led by Zerah and won a great victory with God's help.
